## Objective

Write the **Primary** set's per-cell effort and the static cell covariates
as rasters, so they can be overlaid with other gridded fisheries data (NOAA
fishing footprints, VMS and VTR products) or opened in any GIS (D-067). This
is an output step only: nothing in 06 onward reads these files, and no
analysis table changes.

The rasters sit on GFW's own 0.01° lattice in EPSG:4326, so each grid cell
is exactly one pixel and nothing is resampled. The extent is the AOI's
bounding box snapped outward to the lattice and padded by one cell, so every
pipeline version is written on the same extent. Grid cells with no effort
are `0`; pixels outside the grid are `NA`.

Effort comes from 04's zero-filled cell tables, not from 05's analysis
tables, because only 04 carries `n_mmsi` for all gears together. Each
gear's vessel count, and the all-gear count, is a **distinct** count within
its cell and time window. It does not add across cells, gears or time, so
the `all` layer is read from 04's all-gear table, never summed from the gear
layers. Hours do add, and the gate checks that the gear layers sum to `all`.

| Output (`data/processed/rasters/{pipeline}/`) | Contents |
|---|---|
| `{vp,afe}_primary_hours_{stage,month}.tif` | hours, one layer per gear × stage or month (Float64) |
| `{vp,afe}_primary_nmmsi_{stage,month}.tif` | distinct MMSIs, same layers (Int32) |
| `{vp,afe}_primary_{stage,month}.nc` | both variables per gear (`hours_{gear}`, `n_mmsi_{gear}`) on lon × lat × time |
| `cell_covariates.tif`, `cell_covariates.nc` | static covariates from `cells.gpkg` |

Gears are `all` plus the three analysis gears (`mobile`, `fixed`,
`pole_and_line`). `UNRESOLVED` holds no Primary hours, which the gate
checks, so it is not written. GeoTIFF layers are named `{gear}_{time}`, with
`stage1`–`stage3` or `YYYY-MM` for the time. The NetCDF time values are
each stage's or month's first day. Every file has a `<file>.json`
provenance sidecar. Fields are defined in `references/data_dictionary.md`.

The **gate** at the end collects every check. The step passes only if all
of them hold.

## Libraries and shared code

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(ncdf4)

source("r/paths.R")
source("r/gfw_helpers.R")
source("r/vessel_helpers.R")
source("r/analysis_helpers.R")

# Quarto parameters (header); `params` is read-only while rendering. Run chunk
# by chunk, `params` is missing or left over from another session, so the
# header is read from this file directly instead
qparams <- if (isTRUE(getOption("knitr.in.progress"))) params else {
  hdr <- knitr::knit_params(readLines(
    file.path(root, "r/05a_export_rasters.qmd"), warn = FALSE))
  lapply(hdr, function(p) p$value)
}
paths <- gfw_paths_with(qparams)

set.seed(42) # workflow-wide seed (plan, FAIR); nothing here is random

datasets   <- c("vp", "afe")
time_steps <- c("stage", "month")
# 04's time column for each time step
time_col   <- c(stage = "Development Stage", month = "Year Month")
# layer and variable names use lower-case gear tokens; `all` comes first
gears      <- c("all", tolower(analysis_gears))
pull_date  <- as.character(read_pull_date(paths))

# every check the gate needs, filled in as the steps run
gate <- tibble(check = character(), pass = logical())
check <- function(name, ok) {
  gate <<- add_row(gate, check = name, pass = isTRUE(ok))
  invisible(ok)
}
```

## Step 1: read the grid and the Primary cell tables

The grid supplies each cell's lattice indices. For each dataset and time
step, the all-gear table gives the `all` rows and the gear table the three
analysis gears, both filtered to Primary.

```{r}
grid <- st_read(paths$grid, quiet = TRUE) |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  select(cell_id, ix, iy)

# one of 04's zero-filled cell tables, Primary rows only, with `hours`,
# `n_mmsi`, `time` and a lower-case `gear` column
cell_table_path <- function(ds, tm, by_gear) {
  file.path(paths$interim_gfw, sprintf("gfw_%s_cell_%s%s_sets.csv",
                                       ds, tm, if (by_gear) "_gear" else ""))
}
read_cell_table <- function(ds, tm, by_gear) {
  t <- read_csv(cell_table_path(ds, tm, by_gear),
                col_types = cols(cell_id = "c", set = "c", n_mmsi = "i", .default = "?")) |>
    filter(set == "primary") |>
    select(-set) |>
    rename(hours = paste0(ds, "_hours"), time = all_of(time_col[[tm]]))
  if (by_gear) mutate(t, gear = tolower(gear_class), .keep = "unused") else mutate(t, gear = "all")
}

effort <- list()
for (ds in datasets) for (tm in time_steps) {
  by_gear <- read_cell_table(ds, tm, by_gear = TRUE)
  # UNRESOLVED is a structural zero in Primary (05, step 1): check it, then drop it
  unres <- filter(by_gear, gear == "unresolved")
  check(sprintf("%s %s: Primary UNRESOLVED holds 0 h and 0 vessels", ds, tm),
        sum(unres$hours) == 0 && all(unres$n_mmsi == 0))
  effort[[ds]][[tm]] <- bind_rows(read_cell_table(ds, tm, by_gear = FALSE),
                                  filter(by_gear, gear != "unresolved")) |>
    left_join(grid, by = "cell_id")
}

# the time values each table must cover: the three stages, and every month
# of the analysis window
time_levels <- list(stage = dev_stages$stage,
                    month = seq(as.Date(analysis_start), as.Date(analysis_end), by = "month"))

for (ds in datasets) for (tm in time_steps) {
  t <- effort[[ds]][[tm]]
  check(sprintf("%s %s: every row is on the grid", ds, tm), !anyNA(t$ix))
  check(sprintf("%s %s: one row per grid cell × %s × gear (zero-filled)", ds, tm, tm),
        nrow(t) == nrow(grid) * length(time_levels[[tm]]) * length(gears) &&
          !anyDuplicated(select(t, cell_id, time, gear)) &&
          setequal(t$time, time_levels[[tm]]) && setequal(t$gear, gears))
}
```

## Step 2: the raster template

The AOI's bounding box on the 0.01° lattice, padded by one cell
(`lattice_template()` in `r/analysis_helpers.R`). The same AOI gives the same
template for every pipeline version.

```{r}
aoi      <- st_read(paths$aoi, quiet = TRUE)
template <- lattice_template(aoi)
template

# the lattice edges as indices; an exact lattice gives whole numbers
edges <- as.vector(ext(template)) * 100
check("template: EPSG:4326, 0.01° pixels, edges on the lattice",
      crs(template, describe = TRUE)$code == "4326" &&
        isTRUE(all.equal(res(template), c(0.01, 0.01))) &&
        all(abs(edges - round(edges)) < 1e-6))
# raster_cells() stops on a cell outside the template; this records it
check("template: every grid cell is inside it",
      !inherits(try(raster_cells(grid$ix, grid$iy, template), silent = TRUE), "try-error"))
```

## Step 3: build the effort rasters

One raster per dataset × time step × variable × gear, with one layer per
stage or month. The GeoTIFF stacks the four gears; the NetCDF keeps each
gear as its own variable with a time dimension.

```{r}
# per time step: layer labels, and the date each layer starts on
time_label <- list(
  stage = \(x) sub("Stage ", "stage", x, fixed = TRUE),
  month = \(x) format(x, "%Y-%m"))
time_start <- list(
  stage = \(x) as.Date(dev_stages$start[match(x, dev_stages$stage)]),
  month = \(x) x)

variables <- c(hours = "hours", n_mmsi = "n_mmsi")

# build[[ds]][[tm]][[var]][[gear]]: a SpatRaster with one layer per time value
build <- list()
for (ds in datasets) for (tm in time_steps) {
  labels <- time_label[[tm]](time_levels[[tm]])
  dates  <- time_start[[tm]](time_levels[[tm]])
  for (var in names(variables)) for (g in gears) {
    t <- filter(effort[[ds]][[tm]], gear == g)
    r <- cells_to_raster(t$ix, t$iy, time_label[[tm]](t$time), t[[var]],
                         template, layers = labels)
    time(r) <- dates
    build[[ds]][[tm]][[var]][[g]] <- r
  }
}
```

## Step 4: write the effort rasters

GeoTIFFs are DEFLATE-compressed. Hours are written as Float64, so every
pixel equals its table value exactly, and counts as Int32. The NetCDF
carries the same values. ncdf4 then adds attributes that terra does not
write: the source, the set and pipeline, the stage definitions, and on each
count variable a note that it does not add.

```{r}
dir.create(paths$rasters, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

tif_type  <- c(hours = "FLT8S", n_mmsi = "INT4S")
nc_prec   <- c(hours = "double", n_mmsi = "integer")
units_of  <- c(hours = "hours", n_mmsi = "vessels")
long_name <- c(vp = "vessel presence", afe = "apparent fishing effort")
file_var  <- c(hours = "hours", n_mmsi = "nmmsi") # file-name token for each variable

# what each variable is, and whether it adds across pixels, gears and time
var_comment <- c(
  hours  = "Sum of hours in the cell over the layer's time window. Adds across cells, gears and time.",
  n_mmsi = paste("Distinct MMSIs with records in the cell over the layer's time window.",
                 "Does NOT add across cells, gears or time: recompute from the records."))

effort_inputs <- \(ds, tm) c(cell_table_path(ds, tm, FALSE), cell_table_path(ds, tm, TRUE),
                             paths$grid, paths$aoi)
written <- tibble(file = character(), layers = integer())

for (ds in datasets) for (tm in time_steps) {
  # GeoTIFF: one file per variable, the four gears stacked
  for (var in names(variables)) {
    r <- rast(unname(build[[ds]][[tm]][[var]]))
    names(r) <- unlist(map(gears, \(g) paste0(g, "_", names(build[[ds]][[tm]][[var]][[g]]))))
    f <- file.path(paths$rasters, sprintf("%s_primary_%s_%s.tif", ds, file_var[[var]], tm))
    writeRaster(r, f, datatype = tif_type[[var]], gdal = "COMPRESS=DEFLATE", overwrite = TRUE)
    write_provenance(f, effort_inputs(ds, tm), extra = list(
      dataset = ds, time_step = tm, set = "primary", variable = var,
      units = units_of[[var]], additive = var == "hours", pull_date = pull_date,
      crs = "EPSG:4326", resolution_deg = 0.01, extent = as.vector(ext(r)),
      layers = names(r)))
    written <- add_row(written, file = basename(f), layers = nlyr(r))
  }

  # NetCDF: one variable per variable × gear, each with a time dimension
  # hours for the four gears, then n_mmsi for the four gears, as nc_vars below
  s <- sds(list_flatten(map(names(variables), \(var) unname(build[[ds]][[tm]][[var]]))))
  # one row per NetCDF variable, gears varying fastest to match `s`
  nc_grid <- expand_grid(var = names(variables), gear = gears)
  nc_vars <- paste0(nc_grid$var, "_", nc_grid$gear)
  names(s) <- nc_vars
  longnames(s) <- sprintf("%s %s, %s gear, Primary set", long_name[[ds]],
                          if_else(nc_grid$var == "hours", "hours", "distinct vessels (MMSI)"),
                          nc_grid$gear)
  units(s) <- unname(units_of[nc_grid$var])
  f <- file.path(paths$rasters, sprintf("%s_primary_%s.nc", ds, tm))
  writeCDF(s, f, prec = unname(nc_prec[nc_grid$var]),
           zname = "time", compression = 4, overwrite = TRUE)

  nc <- nc_open(f, write = TRUE)
  ncatt_put(nc, 0, "title", sprintf("GFW %s, Primary set, by cell and %s", long_name[[ds]], tm))
  ncatt_put(nc, 0, "source", sprintf(
    "Global Fishing Watch 4Wings API, pipeline %s, pulled %s; Primary set classified by r/04_classify_aggregate.qmd",
    paths$pipeline, pull_date))
  ncatt_put(nc, 0, "pipeline", paths$pipeline)
  ncatt_put(nc, 0, "set", "primary")
  ncatt_put(nc, 0, "grid", "GFW 4Wings 0.01 degree lattice, EPSG:4326; cell (ix, iy) spans [ix, ix+1]/100 lon, [iy, iy+1]/100 lat")
  ncatt_put(nc, 0, "fill", "0 = grid cell with no effort; missing = outside the grid")
  ncatt_put(nc, 0, "license", "Data (c) Global Fishing Watch, CC BY-SA 4.0")
  ncatt_put(nc, 0, "decision", "D-067, planning/decisions.md")
  if (tm == "stage") {
    # the time values are stage start dates; name the stages they stand for
    ncatt_put(nc, 0, "stage_names", paste(dev_stages$stage, collapse = "; "))
    ncatt_put(nc, 0, "stage_start", paste(dev_stages$start, collapse = "; "))
    ncatt_put(nc, 0, "stage_end",   paste(dev_stages$end,   collapse = "; "))
  }
  for (v in nc_vars) {
    var <- if (startsWith(v, "hours_")) "hours" else "n_mmsi"
    ncatt_put(nc, v, "comment", var_comment[[var]])
    ncatt_put(nc, v, "additive", if (var == "hours") "true" else "false")
  }
  nc_close(nc)

  write_provenance(f, effort_inputs(ds, tm), extra = list(
    dataset = ds, time_step = tm, set = "primary", pull_date = pull_date,
    crs = "EPSG:4326", resolution_deg = 0.01, extent = as.vector(ext(template)),
    variables = nc_vars, time = as.character(time_start[[tm]](time_levels[[tm]]))))
  written <- add_row(written, file = basename(f), layers = length(nc_vars) * length(time_levels[[tm]]))
}
```

## Step 5: the static covariates

The static fields of `cells.gpkg` (05), one layer each. Categorical fields
are stored as integer codes, listed in the sidecar and in the NetCDF
`flag_values` / `flag_meanings` attributes, and the gear-domain flags as
0/1. Two fields are left out. `dist_band` is a binning of `dist_lease_km`.
`x_km` and `y_km` are UTM centroids, which a lon/lat raster already
carries.

```{r}
cells <- st_read(file.path(paths$analysis, "cells.gpkg"), quiet = TRUE) |>
  st_drop_geometry()
check("covariates: cells.gpkg holds the same cells as the grid",
      setequal(cells$cell_id, grid$cell_id) && nrow(cells) == nrow(grid))

# categorical fields and their codes (1, 2, ... in this order)
categories <- list(aoi_class = c("inside", "edge", "outside"),
                   nearest_project = c("SFW", "RWF", "SRW"))
check("covariates: every categorical value has a code",
      all(imap_lgl(categories, \(lv, col) all(cells[[col]] %in% lv))))

covariate_cols <- c("area_km2", "aoi_frac", "aoi_class", "dist_lease_km", "nearest_project",
                    "depth_m", "depth_sd_m", "slope_deg", "bpi_broad",
                    "d_found_final_km", "d_cable_km",
                    grep("^domain_", names(cells), value = TRUE))
cov <- cells |>
  mutate(across(all_of(names(categories)), \(x) match(x, categories[[cur_column()]])),
         across(starts_with("domain_"), as.integer)) |>
  select(ix, iy, all_of(covariate_cols)) |>
  pivot_longer(all_of(covariate_cols), names_to = "layer", values_to = "value")

cov_r <- cells_to_raster(cov$ix, cov$iy, cov$layer, as.numeric(cov$value), template,
                         layers = covariate_cols)
# integer-coded layers: the categorical codes and the 0/1 domain flags
int_layers <- c(names(categories), grep("^domain_", covariate_cols, value = TRUE))

f_tif <- file.path(paths$rasters, "cell_covariates.tif")
writeRaster(cov_r, f_tif, datatype = "FLT8S", gdal = "COMPRESS=DEFLATE", overwrite = TRUE)

cov_s <- sds(as.list(cov_r))
names(cov_s) <- covariate_cols
f_nc <- file.path(paths$rasters, "cell_covariates.nc")
writeCDF(cov_s, f_nc, prec = if_else(covariate_cols %in% int_layers, "integer", "double"),
         compression = 4, overwrite = TRUE)
nc <- nc_open(f_nc, write = TRUE)
ncatt_put(nc, 0, "title", "Static cell covariates (cells.gpkg, r/05_prepare_analysis.qmd)")
ncatt_put(nc, 0, "pipeline", paths$pipeline)
ncatt_put(nc, 0, "grid", "GFW 4Wings 0.01 degree lattice, EPSG:4326")
ncatt_put(nc, 0, "decision", "D-067, planning/decisions.md")
for (col in names(categories)) {
  ncatt_put(nc, col, "flag_values", seq_along(categories[[col]]), prec = "int")
  ncatt_put(nc, col, "flag_meanings", paste(categories[[col]], collapse = " "))
}
for (col in grep("^domain_", covariate_cols, value = TRUE)) {
  ncatt_put(nc, col, "flag_values", 0:1, prec = "int")
  ncatt_put(nc, col, "flag_meanings", "inactive active")
}
nc_close(nc)

for (f in c(f_tif, f_nc)) {
  write_provenance(f, c(file.path(paths$analysis, "cells.gpkg"), paths$grid, paths$aoi),
                   extra = list(pipeline = paths$pipeline, crs = "EPSG:4326",
                                resolution_deg = 0.01, layers = covariate_cols,
                                codes = categories,
                                domain_flags = "0 = inactive, 1 = active in Stage 1"))
  written <- add_row(written, file = basename(f), layers = length(covariate_cols))
}

written
```

## Gate

Every file is read back from disk and compared with the tables it came
from. Each grid cell's pixel must equal its table value exactly, every other
pixel must be NA, and the NetCDF must match the GeoTIFF. For hours, the
three gear layers must sum to `all`.

```{r}
# the pixel number of every row of a table, and the layer it belongs to
pixel_of <- \(t) raster_cells(t$ix, t$iy, template)

# two pixel matrices hold the same data: missing in the same pixels, and
# exactly equal everywhere else. Missing pixels can come back as NA from one
# format and NaN from the other, which identical() alone would count as a
# difference
same_pixels <- function(a, b) {
  a <- unname(as.numeric(a))
  b <- unname(as.numeric(b))
  identical(is.na(a), is.na(b)) && identical(a[!is.na(a)], b[!is.na(b)])
}

for (ds in datasets) for (tm in time_steps) {
  t   <- effort[[ds]][[tm]] |> mutate(label = paste0(gear, "_", time_label[[tm]](time)))
  pix <- pixel_of(t)
  for (var in names(variables)) {
    f <- file.path(paths$rasters, sprintf("%s_primary_%s_%s.tif", ds, file_var[[var]], tm))
    m <- values(rast(f))
    idx <- cbind(pix, match(t$label, colnames(m)))
    check(sprintf("%s %s %s .tif: every grid pixel equals the table, every other pixel is NA",
                  ds, tm, var),
          !anyNA(idx) && identical(as.numeric(m[idx]), as.numeric(t[[var]])) &&
            sum(!is.na(m)) == nrow(t))

    # NetCDF: each gear's variable against the same GeoTIFF columns
    s <- sds(file.path(paths$rasters, sprintf("%s_primary_%s.nc", ds, tm)))
    same <- map_lgl(gears, \(g) {
      cols <- startsWith(colnames(m), paste0(g, "_"))
      same_pixels(values(s[[paste0(var, "_", g)]]), m[, cols])
    })
    check(sprintf("%s %s %s .nc: identical to the GeoTIFF", ds, tm, var), all(same))
  }

  # hours add: the three gear layers sum to `all`, time value by time value
  h <- values(rast(file.path(paths$rasters, sprintf("%s_primary_hours_%s.tif", ds, tm))))
  labels <- time_label[[tm]](time_levels[[tm]])
  gear_sum <- Reduce(`+`, map(tolower(analysis_gears), \(g) h[, paste0(g, "_", labels)]))
  check(sprintf("%s %s: gear hours sum to all-gear hours in every pixel", ds, tm),
        isTRUE(all.equal(unname(gear_sum), unname(h[, paste0("all_", labels)]))))
}

# covariates: GeoTIFF and NetCDF against the coded table
cov_pix <- cbind(pixel_of(cov), match(cov$layer, covariate_cols))
m_tif <- values(rast(f_tif))
m_nc  <- do.call(cbind, map(covariate_cols, \(col) values(sds(f_nc)[[col]])))
check("covariates .tif: every grid pixel equals cells.gpkg, every other pixel is NA",
      identical(as.numeric(m_tif[cov_pix]), as.numeric(cov$value)) &&
        sum(!is.na(m_tif)) == nrow(cov))
check("covariates .nc: identical to the GeoTIFF",
      same_pixels(m_nc, m_tif))

gate |> mutate(pass = if_else(pass, "pass", "FAIL")) |> knitr::kable()

stopifnot("Raster export gate failed; see the table above" = all(gate$pass))
```
